text: PLACEHOLDER: Metro Center has elevator access from street level to the mezzanine and from the mezzanine to both the Red Line and Blue/Orange/Silver Line platforms. All entrances are accessible.
PLACEHOLDER: Union Station has a street-level elevator at the main entrance and platform elevators serving the Red Line. Escalator outages are common during peak commuter rail transfer times.
PLACEHOLDER: Dupont Circle's south entrance (19th St) has no elevator; wheelchair users should use the north entrance (Q St), which has full elevator access to the platform.

PLACEHOLDER: Gallery Place-Chinatown has elevator access at all entrances and between both the Red Line and Green/Yellow Line platforms, though transfers require exiting fare gates at street level during certain elevator outages.
PLACEHOLDER: Rosslyn has a single long escalator bank and one elevator connecting the mezzanine to the platform; the elevator is the only accessible path when escalators are under maintenance.
PLACEHOLDER: Single-tracking between Metro Center and Gallery Place-Chinatown on the Red Line due to weekend track maintenance, resulting in delays of up to 15 minutes.
PLACEHOLDER: Elevator at the Q St entrance to Dupont Circle was out of service for approximately two weeks for a scheduled motor replacement.
PLACEHOLDER: Systemwide reduced service on a federal holiday, with trains running on a weekend schedule across all six lines.
PLACEHOLDER: SmarTrip fares are calculated by distance traveled and time of day; peak fares apply on weekdays roughly 5-9:30am and 3-7pm, with off-peak (lower) fares at all other times.
PLACEHOLDER: Bikes are permitted on Metrorail at all times except during designated peak-hour restrictions on certain lines; folding bikes are always allowed.
PLACEHOLDER: Free transfers between Metrorail and Metrobus are available within a set time window when paying with the same SmarTrip card.
